name: makeaivideo
description: Official MakeAIVideo MCP server for creating short-form AI videos (script, AI voiceover, AI or stock scenes, captions and music) from a prompt or script, returning the MP4, and posting or scheduling it to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other connected accounts.

MAKEAIVIDEO_API_KEY.description: MakeAIVideo API key for local stdio or bearer authentication, from https://app.makeaivideo.ai/developers. Never commit your key. Videos use account credits.

npm.description: Local stdio. Requires Node.js 18+ and a MakeAIVideo account with credits.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in to MakeAIVideo. Videos use account credits.

http-api-key.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP using a MakeAIVideo API key instead of OAuth. Videos use account credits.
